title: Director Parts ReMan Operations
text:
Our employees are the most important part of our business. Thank you for your interest in applying to new opportunities with us.

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services, and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results, and help move society forward.

The Director, Global Parts Reman Operations will play a key role in our organization. This team member will lead the effort in defining and executing global standard process for ReMan Operations to meet Customer SLAs, meet quality standards and drive cost productivity. For this role to be successful they must partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, Procurement, Field teams, as well as Parts Planning and Logistics teams. Success in this role will increase service levels, and drive material cost productivity while enabling revenue growth and margin improvement for the business. Reporting to this leader are the are the ReMan teams.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Partner with the teams mentioned above to define/refine strategy, SLAs, KPIs, operational processes and interaction model.
* Ensure Service and Aftermarket parts feedback is incorporated into the process; end-to-end from VOC (voice of customer) to performance
* Establish forums for cross team collaboration

* Drive parts productivity programs, that will increase margin and service
* Partner with field teams to drive growth through offerings and service improvements.

* Establish scaling process with timelines
* Coach and develop team members and manage organizational talent through performance management, succession planning and development.

**Minimal Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated leadership experience in Repair Center Operations
* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Engineering, Business, Operations Management, or related field OR equivalent experience.
* 10 years progressive management experience within operations, aftermarket, service, engineering or supply chain.
* Willingness to travel both domestic and internationally (20-30%) to develop firsthand understanding of sites and the wider organizational challenges

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Advance Degree, MS and/or MBA
* Strong Lean background
* Experience in collaborating with multiple sites and business units to achieve business objectives
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior management, teams and individuals across multiple cultures, disciplines, and geographies.
* Strong verbal and written communication competencies
* Solid quantitative skill set and the ability to analyze, think and communicate with well-supported data
* Experience driving organizational transformations
* Familiarity with the building technologies market.

*#LI-Remote*
